title: Hornets send Miles Bridges to Suns in trade involving Grayson Allen, Royce O’Neale: Source
content:
The Charlotte Hornets are trading veteran forward Miles Bridges and two future draft picks to the Phoenix Suns in exchange for guard Grayson Allen, forward Royce O’Neale and a future first-round pick, a team source confirmed to The Athletic.

The Suns will receive a 2029 first-round pick and a 2027 second-round pick in the deal, while the Hornets get back a 2033 first-round pick.

Earlier this week, the Hornets swung a deal to send LaMelo Ball to the Minnesota Timberwolves for Naz Reid and draft compensation.

This story will be updated.
